levels.name: Palm Beach
levels.description: Sun-drenched sandy shores with palm boughs, gentle tutorial platforms, Hermit Scuttlers, Waystone 1, and the First Ancient Lighthouse.

levels.name: Overgrown Ruins
levels.description: Vertical stone masonry ruins covered in coastal moss, crumbling stone arches, Spiny Urchins, Barnaby the Navigator, Waystone 2, and the Second Ancient Lighthouse.

levels.name: Flooded Caves
levels.description: Subterranean tidal grotto with disappearing coral ledges, pulsing geysers, Bubble Ray Flyers, Spiny Urchins, Waystone 3, and the sacred Shrine of the Tide Dash.

levels.name: Wind Cliffs
levels.description: Dramatic ocean cliffs featuring strong coastal updrafts, oscillating cloud shelves, aggressive Coral Crusher Crabs, Waystone 4, and the Third Ancient Lighthouse.

levels.name: Lighthouse Island & Boss Arena
levels.description: The ultimate platforming gauntlet leading to the Ancient Beacon Keeper, Waystone 5, The Ancient Tide Golem coliseum, the Final Beacon, and the Grand Ending Altar.

enemyTypes.name: Hermit Scuttler
enemyTypes.behavior: Patrols platforms with edge and wall detection, turning around upon reaching boundaries. Stompable from above.

enemyTypes.name: Spiny Urchin
enemyTypes.behavior: Rhythmic squash telegraph for 0.25s, jumps vertically with -350px/s impulse. Stompable at apex or descent.

enemyTypes.name: Bubble Ray Flyer
enemyTypes.behavior: Smooth sine-wave flight pattern. Acts as an aerial stepping stone; stomping it resets Cori's Tide Dash.

enemyTypes.name: Coral Crusher Crab
enemyTypes.behavior: Patrols until player is within 180px line-of-sight. Winds up for 0.4s and charges at 280px/s. Crashes into solid walls entering a 2.2s dazed stun where it becomes vulnerable to stomps.

phases.description: Leaps and slams ground creating a traveling tidal shockwave. Coral core exposes at head level for 3.5s.
Hurls bouncing coral boulders that ricochet across the arena. Slam wave moves 25% faster. Core exposed for 2.6s.
Pressurized water jets rain down from ceiling geysers, followed by double shockwave slams and an enraged charge into the arena wall causing a 2.2s wall crash stun.

npcs.name: Coralia the Pearl Diver
dialogue: Ahoy there, little Cori! The coastal tempests have extinguished the Three Ancient Lighthouses, and dark tides churn across the archipelago.
Collect the 5 Sun Pearls scattered across each reef to restore their radiance. Press [Space] to leap, and stomp atop Hermit Scuttlers to bounce safely!
Seek out my old sailing partner Barnaby in the Overgrown Ruins ahead. Keep your antennae glowing bright, little sprite!

npcs.name: Barnaby the Navigator
dialogue: Shiver me barnacles! You made it past the outer reefs, young Cori. The ancient masonry here holds strong, but the waters are rising fast.
Deep within the Flooded Caves lies the sacred Shrine of the Tide Dash. Once attuned, you can press [Shift] or [J] mid-air to surge through the sea breeze!
Beware the Coral Crusher Crabs on the high cliffs. Their thick armor can only be cracked when they daze themselves against hard stone walls!

npcs.name: Ancient Beacon Keeper
dialogue: Cori, child of the tides! You have awakened the ancient beacons and calmed the fury of the Tide Golem.
All 4 Lighthouses ignite across the horizon! The storm subsides and the coral isles flourish once more.
May the great ocean cradle guide your travels forever, Master Navigator of the Reefs!

medallions.name: Medallion of the Tides
medallions.lore: When the first ocean cooled, the Tidal Core gave life to the coral reefs and whispered rhythm to the sea.

medallions.name: Medallion of the Deep Ruins
medallions.lore: The ancient seafolk built towers to mirror the constellations, harnessing starlight to guide distant voyagers.

medallions.name: Medallion of the Flooded Grotto
medallions.lore: Deep within the flooded grottos, bioluminescent currents pulse with the heartbeat of the sleeping sentinel.

medallions.name: Medallion of the Sea Gale
medallions.lore: The cliff winds sing an unbroken sea shanty, lifting those who dare to leap with faith into the updraft.

medallions.name: Medallion of the Horizon Beacon
medallions.lore: When all four beacons shine upon the horizon, the tempest calms and the ocean cradle enters eternal harmony.
